title: A Statistical Framework for Data-dependent Retrieval-Augmented Models
authors: Soumya Basu; Ankit Singh Rawat; Manzil Zaheer
why_relevant: Provides a statistical framework and excess risk bounds for retrieval-augmented models, which could offer theoretical grounding when discussing generalization of RAG, but does not directly address robustness, noise, conflict, or adversarial issues.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on training objectives and generalization theory, not on unreliable evidence or any of the survey's core robustness themes.
